sourceFormat: Native Harbor agy full transcript and stream-json

events.content: Create a single-file HTML page (/app/index.html) with all CSS and JavaScript inline and zero external assets. Never use image generation tools or models. Draw the scene with code (HTML, CSS, SVG, canvas or WebGL); embedded raster artwork is disallowed. Render a dark, atmospheric hero scene featuring a single, steaming bowl of vegan ramen as the sole visual focus. Make the dish feel alive and appetizing — with natural motion, ambient warmth, and interactive response to the mouse. Keep the scene pure (no UI, text, or menus), responsive on all screens, and respectful of prefers-reduced-motion.

input.Content:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
  <title>Vegan Ramen</title>
  <style>
    *, *::before, *::after {
      box-sizing: border-box;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
    }

    html, body {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      overflow: hidden;
      background-color: #070504;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
    }

    canvas {
      display: block;
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      touch-action: none;
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <canvas id="scene" aria-label="A steaming bowl of vegan ramen"></canvas>

  <script>
    (() => {
      const canvas = document.getElementById('scene');
      const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

      const reducedMotionQuery = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)');
      let prefersReducedMotion = reducedMotionQuery.matches;

      let width = 0;
      let height = 0;
      let dpr = 1;
      let time = 0;
      let lastTime = performance.now();
      let rafId = null;

      // Mouse / pointer state (normalized -1 to 1 from center)
      const pointer = {
        x: 0,
        y: 0,
        targetX: 0,
        targetY: 0,
        vx: 0,
        vy: 0,
        lastX: 0,
        lastY: 0,
        active: false
      };

      // Steam particles
      const steamWisps = [];
      const STEAM_COUNT = 26;

      // Oil droplets on broth
      const oilDroplets = [];
      const OIL_COUNT = 28;

      // Ambient warm dust/embers
      const embers = [];
      const EMBER_COUNT = 18;

      function rand(min, max) {
        return min + Math.random() * (max - min);
      }

      function initParticles() {
        steamWisps.length = 0;
        for (let i = 0; i < STEAM_COUNT; i++) {
          steamWisps.push({
            xOffset: rand(-0.65, 0.65),
            yProgress: rand(0, 1),
            speed: rand(0.08, 0.16),
            amplitude: rand(10, 28),
            freq: rand(1.4, 3.0),
            phase: rand(0, Math.PI * 2),
            width: rand(18, 46),
            opacity: rand(0.05, 0.13),
            driftX: 0
          });
        }

        oilDroplets.length = 0;
        for (let i = 0; i < OIL_COUNT; i++) {
          const angle = rand(0, Math.PI * 2);
          const dist = Math.sqrt(rand(0.05, 0.85));
          oilDroplets.push({
            rx: Math.cos(angle) * dist,
            ry: Math.sin(angle) * dist,
            radius: rand(1.8, 6.2),
            phase: rand(0, Math.PI * 2),
            speed: rand(0.4, 1.1),
            isChili: Math.random() < 0.35
          });
        }

        embers.length = 0;
        for (let i = 0; i < EMBER_COUNT; i++) {
          embers.push({
            x: rand(-1, 1),
            y: rand(-1, 1),
            size: rand(1, 2.6),
            speedY: rand(0.015, 0.045),
            phase: rand(0, Math.PI * 2),
            alpha: rand(0.12, 0.4)
          });
        }
      }

      function resize() {
        dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
        width = window.innerWidth;
        height = window.innerHeight;
        canvas.width = Math.floor(width * dpr);
        canvas.height = Math.floor(height * dpr);
        ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
        if (prefersReducedMotion) {
          drawFrame(0);
        }
      }

      function onPointerMove(e) {
        if (prefersReducedMotion) return;
        const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
        const nx = ((e.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width) * 2 - 1;
        const ny = ((e.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height) * 2 - 1;
        pointer.targetX = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, nx));
        pointer.targetY = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, ny));
        pointer.active = true;
      }

      function onPointerLeave() {
        pointer.targetX = 0;
        pointer.targetY = 0;
        pointer.active = false;
      }

      // Draw a single ramen noodle strand with highlight
      function drawNoodleStrand(cx, cy, r, startX, startY, cp1x, cp1y, cp2x, cp2y, endX, endY, thickness) {
        ctx.save();
        ctx.lineCap = 'round';
        ctx.lineJoin = 'round';

        // Shadow / depth
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(cx + startX * r, cy + startY * r + 2);
        ctx.bezierCurveTo(
          cx + cp1x * r, cy + cp1y * r + 2,
          cx + cp2x * r, cy + cp2y * r + 2,
          cx + endX * r, cy + endY * r + 2
        );
        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(110, 58, 12, 0.55)';
        ctx.lineWidth = thickness + 2;
        ctx.stroke();

        // Main noodle body
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(cx + startX * r, cy + startY * r);
        ctx.bezierCurveTo(
          cx + cp1x * r, cy + cp1y * r,
          cx + cp2x * r, cy + cp2y * r,
          cx + endX * r, cy + endY * r
        );
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#e8c067';
        ctx.lineWidth = thickness;
        ctx.stroke();

        // Glossy broth highlight
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(cx + startX * r, cy + startY * r - thickness * 0.18);
        ctx.bezierCurveTo(
          cx + cp1x * r, cy + cp1y * r - thickness * 0.18,
          cx + cp2x * r, cy + cp2y * r - thickness * 0.18,
          cx + endX * r, cy + endY * r - thickness * 0.18
        );
        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255, 240, 195, 0.52)';
        ctx.lineWidth = thickness * 0.34;
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.restore();
      }

      function drawBowlAndRamen(cx, cy, r, t, px, py) {
        const tiltX = px * r * 0.035;
        const tiltY = py * r * 0.025;

        // 1. Table shadow & warm ambient bounce
        ctx.save();
        const shadowGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(
          cx + tiltX * 0.4, cy + r * 0.32 + tiltY * 0.4, r * 0.2,
          cx + tiltX * 0.4, cy + r * 0.32 + tiltY * 0.4, r * 1.45
        );
        shadowGrad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.85)');
        shadowGrad.addColorStop(0.55, 'rgba(8, 4, 2, 0.6)');
        shadowGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)');
        ctx.fillStyle = shadowGrad;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(cx + tiltX * 0.4, cy + r * 0.32 + tiltY * 0.4, r * 1.35, r * 0.82, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.restore();

        // 2. Outer ceramic bowl body (3/4 perspective)
        ctx.save();
        const bowlBodyGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(cx - r, cy - r * 0.2, cx + r, cy + r * 0.9);
        bowlBodyGrad.addColorStop(0, '#2a2729');
        bowlBodyGrad.addColorStop(0.35, '#191719');
        bowlBodyGrad.addColorStop(0.75, '#0e0d0f');
        bowlBodyGrad.addColorStop(1, '#1b1615');

        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(cx, cy, r * 1.02, r * 0.72, 0, Math.PI, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.bezierCurveTo(
          cx + r * 1.02, cy + r * 0.52,
          cx + r * 0.56, cy + r * 0.88,
          cx, cy + r * 0.88
        );
        ctx.bezierCurveTo(
          cx - r * 0.56, cy + r * 0.88,
          cx - r * 1.02, cy + r * 0.52,
          cx - r * 1.02, cy
        );
        ctx.closePath();
        ctx.fillStyle = bowlBodyGrad;
        ctx.fill();

        // Subtle warm rim reflection on outer bowl
        const rimGlow = ctx.createRadialGradient(
          cx - r * 0.35 + px * 25, cy + r * 0.25 + py * 15, r * 0.05,
          cx - r * 0.35 + px * 25, cy + r * 0.25 + py * 15, r * 0.85
        );
        rimGlow.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255, 145, 65, 0.11)');
        rimGlow.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255, 145, 65, 0)');
        ctx.fillStyle = rimGlow;
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.restore();

        // 3. Bowl Rim
        ctx.save();
        const rimGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(cx - r, cy - r * 0.72, cx + r, cy + r * 0.72);
        rimGrad.addColorStop(0, '#463b35');
        rimGrad.addColorStop(0.35, '#2b2627');
        rimGrad.addColorStop(0.7, '#181618');
        rimGrad.addColorStop(1, '#3a2d27');

        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(cx, cy, r * 1.02, r * 0.72, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fillStyle = rimGrad;
        ctx.fill();

        // Inner bowl wall
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(cx, cy + r * 0.02, r * 0.94, r * 0.65, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fillStyle = '#141112';
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.restore();

        // 4. Rich Vegan Broth (clipped to inner bowl)
        ctx.save();
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(cx, cy + r * 0.04, r * 0.91, r * 0.62, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.clip();

        const bx = cx + tiltX * 0.6;
        const by = cy + r * 0.04 + tiltY * 0.6;

        const brothGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(
          bx - r * 0.12, by - r * 0.08, r * 0.05,
          bx, by, r * 0.92
        );
        brothGrad.addColorStop(0, '#e58e2c');
        brothGrad.addColorStop(0.42, '#c26118');
        brothGrad.addColorStop(0.78, '#87380b');
        brothGrad.addColorStop(1, '#4d1b05');

        ctx.fillStyle = brothGrad;
        ctx.fillRect(cx - r, cy - r, r * 2, r * 2);

        // Gentle broth shimmer
        const shimmerX = bx + Math.sin(t * 0.7) * r * 0.08 + px * r * 0.12;
        const shimmerY = by - r * 0.12 + Math.cos(t * 0.5) * r * 0.05 + py * r * 0.08;
        const shimmerGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(shimmerX, shimmerY, 2, shimmerX, shimmerY, r * 0.55);
        shimmerGrad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255, 215, 130, 0.22)');
        shimmerGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255, 170, 70, 0)');
        ctx.fillStyle = shimmerGrad;
        ctx.fillRect(cx - r, cy - r, r * 2, r * 2);

        // 5. Ramen Noodles
        const nx = bx;
        const ny = by + r * 0.05;
        const noodleThick = Math.max(3.5, r * 0.036);
        drawNoodleStrand(nx, ny, r, -0.55, 0.05, -0.35, -0.18, -0.05, 0.28, 0.25, 0.08, noodleThick);
        drawNoodleStrand(nx, ny, r, -0.48, 0.20, -0.20, 0.02, 0.05, 0.36, 0.38, 0.18, noodleThick);
        drawNoodleStrand(nx, ny, r, -0.30, -0.10, -0.05, 0.15, 0.18, -0.15, 0.45, 0.05, noodleThick);
        drawNoodleStrand(nx, ny, r, -0.60, 0.12, -0.28, 0.32, -0.02, 0.12, 0.18, 0.35, noodleThick);
        drawNoodleStrand(nx, ny, r, -0.15, 0.28, 0.05, 0.08, 0.28, 0.34, 0.52, 0.22, noodleThick);
        drawNoodleStrand(nx, ny, r, -0.42, -0.02, -0.18, 0.24, 0.12, 0.04, 0.32, 0.28, noodleThick * 0.9);

        // 6. Floating Chili & Sesame Oil Droplets
        for (const d of oilDroplets) {
          const bobX = Math.sin(t * d.speed + d.phase) * r * 0.012;
          const bobY = Math.cos(t * d.speed * 0.8 + d.phase) * r * 0.008;
          const dx = bx + d.rx * r * 0.78 + bobX;
          const dy = by + d.ry * r * 0.50 + bobY;
          const dr = d.radius * (r / 220);

          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.arc(dx, dy, dr, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.fillStyle = d.isChili
            ? 'rgba(218, 56, 18, 0.72)'
            : 'rgba(255, 210, 110, 0.45)';
          ctx.fill();

          // Tiny specular dot
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.arc(dx - dr * 0.3, dy - dr * 0.3, dr * 0.28, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 248, 220, 0.75)';
          ctx.fill();
        }

        // 7. Toppings
        const tx = bx + tiltX * 0.35;
        const ty = by + tiltY * 0.35;

        // Nori (roasted seaweed) tucked at upper-left
        ctx.save();
        ctx.translate(tx - r * 0.46, ty - r * 0.24);
        ctx.rotate(-0.32);
        const noriGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, -r * 0.25, 0, r * 0.25);
        noriGrad.addColorStop(0, '#182419');
        noriGrad.addColorStop(0.6, '#111a12');
        noriGrad.addColorStop(1, '#090e09');
        ctx.fillStyle = noriGrad;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.roundRect(-r * 0.22, -r * 0.22, r * 0.42, r * 0.36, 4);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(70, 95, 65, 0.35)';
        ctx.lineWidth = 1;
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.restore();

        // Baby Bok Choy (emerald green leaves & jade stems) at right
        ctx.save();
        ctx.translate(tx + r * 0.38, ty - r * 0.10);
        ctx.rotate(0.45);
        // Leaves
        for (let i = -1; i <= 1; i++) {
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.ellipse(i * r * 0.08, -r * 0.12, r * 0.12, r * 0.18, i * 0.28, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.fillStyle = i === 0 ? '#2f7a38' : '#23612b';
          ctx.fill();
        }
        // Crisp pale stem
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(0, r * 0.08, r * 0.11, r * 0.14, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fillStyle = '#c8dfb8';
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.restore();

        // Charred Shiitake Mushrooms (upper center-left)
        const drawShiitake = (mx, my, rot, scale) => {
          ctx.save();
          ctx.translate(mx, my);
          ctx.rotate(rot);
          ctx.scale(scale, scale);
          // Cap
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.ellipse(0, 0, r * 0.15, r * 0.10, 0, Math.PI, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.quadraticCurveTo(r * 0.15, r * 0.07, 0, r * 0.06);
          ctx.quadraticCurveTo(-r * 0.15, r * 0.07, -r * 0.15, 0);
          ctx.fillStyle = '#3c2415';
          ctx.fill();
          // Gills / underside
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.ellipse(0, r * 0.02, r * 0.12, r * 0.035, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.fillStyle = '#c49b6c';
          ctx.fill();
          // Glaze highlight
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.ellipse(-r * 0.04, -r * 0.04, r * 0.05, r * 0.02, -0.2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 220, 175, 0.25)';
          ctx.fill();
          ctx.restore();
        };
        drawShiitake(tx - r * 0.14, ty - r * 0.25, -0.2, 1.0);
        drawShiitake(tx + r * 0.06, ty - r * 0.28, 0.25, 0.85);

        // Crispy Pan-Seared Tofu Cubes (left-center)
        const drawTofu = (fx, fy, rot) => {
          ctx.save();
          ctx.translate(fx, fy);
          ctx.rotate(rot);
          const s = r * 0.14;
          // Shadow
          ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(40, 15, 5, 0.45)';
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.roundRect(-s * 0.5 + 3, -s * 0.5 + 4, s, s * 0.85, 4);
          ctx.fill();
          // Tofu body
          const tGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(-s * 0.5, -s * 0.5, s * 0.5, s * 0.5);
          tGrad.addColorStop(0, '#f5e2b8');
          tGrad.addColorStop(0.55, '#e2b56b');
          tGrad.addColorStop(1, '#9c5b22');
          ctx.fillStyle = tGrad;
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.roundRect(-s * 0.5, -s * 0.5, s, s * 0.85, 4);
          ctx.fill();
          // Seared crust edge
          ctx.strokeStyle = '#7d4114';
          ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
          ctx.stroke();
          ctx.restore();
        };
        drawTofu(tx - r * 0.36, ty + r * 0.06, -0.18);
        drawTofu(tx - r * 0.20, ty + r * 0.14, 0.22);

        // Sweet Corn Kernels (lower right)
        const cornPositions = [
          [0.24, 0.22], [0.30, 0.20], [0.27, 0.26],
          [0.34, 0.24], [0.21, 0.26], [0.31, 0.28]
        ];
        for (const [cxOff, cyOff] of cornPositions) {
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.ellipse(tx + cxOff * r, ty + cyOff * r, r * 0.026, r * 0.021, 0.3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.fillStyle = '#f6c83b';
          ctx.fill();
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.arc(tx + cxOff * r - r * 0.007, ty + cyOff * r - r * 0.005, r * 0.008, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 250, 210, 0.7)';
          ctx.fill();
        }

        // Fresh Scallion Rings (scattered)
        const scallions = [
          [-0.04, 0.02, 0.032], [0.06, 0.08, 0.028], [-0.10, 0.12, 0.026],
          [0.14, -0.04, 0.030], [0.02, -0.10, 0.025], [-0.22, -0.08, 0.027]
        ];
        for (const [sxOff, syOff, sr] of scallions) {
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.arc(tx + sxOff * r, ty + syOff * r, sr * r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.strokeStyle = '#5ab847';
          ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(2, r * 0.015);
          ctx.stroke();
        }

        // Toasted Sesame Seeds
        const seeds = [
          [-0.08, -0.02], [0.04, 0.04], [0.12, 0.12], [-0.14, 0.05],
          [0.08, -0.14], [-0.02, 0.18], [0.18, 0.02], [-0.26, -0.02]
        ];
        for (let i = 0; i < seeds.length; i++) {
          const [sdx, sdy] = seeds[i];
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.ellipse(tx + sdx * r, ty + sdy * r, r * 0.012, r * 0.006, i * 0.7, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.fillStyle = i % 3 === 0 ? '#1b1815' : '#f4e3b8';
          ctx.fill();
        }

        // Chili threads (delicate crimson accent at center)
        ctx.save();
        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(220, 48, 22, 0.82)';
        ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1, r * 0.007);
        ctx.lineCap = 'round';
        for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
          ctx.beginPath();
          const ox = tx + (i - 1.5) * r * 0.025;
          const oy = ty - r * 0.04;
          ctx.moveTo(ox - r * 0.04, oy + r * 0.02);
          ctx.quadraticCurveTo(ox, oy - r * 0.03, ox + r * 0.05, oy + r * 0.01);
          ctx.stroke();
        }
        ctx.restore();

        ctx.restore(); // End broth clip

        // 8. Inner rim meniscus highlight
        ctx.save();
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(cx, cy + r * 0.04, r * 0.91, r * 0.62, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255, 195, 120, 0.18)';
        ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.restore();

        // 9. Lacquered Wooden Chopsticks resting on upper-right rim
        ctx.save();
        const chopX = cx + r * 0.42 + tiltX * 0.9;
        const chopY = cy - r * 0.42 + tiltY * 0.9;
        const drawChopstick = (offsetY, angle) => {
          ctx.save();
          ctx.translate(chopX, chopY + offsetY);
          ctx.rotate(angle);
          const len = r * 1.35;
          const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(-len * 0.5, 0, len * 0.5, 0);
          grad.addColorStop(0, '#3e2314');
          grad.addColorStop(0.5, '#26140b');
          grad.addColorStop(1, '#140a05');

          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(-len * 0.55, -r * 0.012);
          ctx.lineTo(len * 0.45, -r * 0.028);
          ctx.lineTo(len * 0.45, r * 0.028);
          ctx.lineTo(-len * 0.55, r * 0.012);
          ctx.closePath();
          ctx.fillStyle = grad;
          ctx.fill();

          // Specular highlight along chopstick
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(-len * 0.52, -r * 0.006);
          ctx.lineTo(len * 0.42, -r * 0.015);
          ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255, 200, 150, 0.22)';
          ctx.lineWidth = 1.2;
          ctx.stroke();
          ctx.restore();
        };
        drawChopstick(0, -0.34);
        drawChopstick(r * 0.06, -0.30);
        ctx.restore();
      }

      function drawSteam(cx, cy, r, t, dt) {
        ctx.save();
        for (const w of steamWisps) {
          if (!prefersReducedMotion) {
            w.yProgress += w.speed * dt;
            if (w.yProgress > 1) {
              w.yProgress -= 1;
              w.xOffset = rand(-0.65, 0.65);
              w.driftX = 0;
            }
            // Mouse turbulence
            const mouseForce = pointer.vx * 45;
            w.driftX += (mouseForce - w.driftX) * 0.04;
          }

          const progress = w.yProgress;
          const fade = Math.sin(progress * Math.PI);
          const alpha = w.opacity * fade;
          if (alpha <= 0.002) continue;

          const startX = cx + w.xOffset * r * 0.72;
          const startY = cy - r * 0.05;
          const riseHeight = r * 1.45;
          const curY = startY - progress * riseHeight;
          const sway = Math.sin(progress * w.freq * Math.PI + t * 1.3 + w.phase) * w.amplitude * (0.4 + progress);
          const curX = startX + sway + w.driftX * progress;
          const wRadius = w.width * (0.7 + progress * 1.25) * (r / 220);

          const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(curX, curY, 0, curX, curY, wRadius);
          grad.addColorStop(0, `rgba(255, 242, 225, ${alpha})`);
          grad.addColorStop(0.5, `rgba(255, 232, 205, ${alpha * 0.45})`);
          grad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255, 220, 190, 0)');

          ctx.fillStyle = grad;
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.arc(curX, curY, wRadius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.fill();
        }
        ctx.restore();
      }

      function drawEmbers(t, dt) {
        ctx.save();
        for (const e of embers) {
          if (!prefersReducedMotion) {
            e.y -= e.speedY * dt;
            if (e.y < -1.1) {
              e.y = 1.1;
              e.x = rand(-1, 1);
            }
          }
          const ex = width * 0.5 + e.x * width * 0.48 + Math.sin(t * 0.8 + e.phase) * 14;
          const ey = height * 0.5 + e.y * height * 0.48;
          const pulse = 0.65 + 0.35 * Math.sin(t * 1.6 + e.phase);

          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.arc(ex, ey, e.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255, 175, 95, ${e.alpha * pulse})`;
          ctx.fill();
        }
        ctx.restore();
      }

      function drawFrame(dt) {
        // Smooth pointer interpolation
        if (!prefersReducedMotion) {
          pointer.vx = (pointer.targetX - pointer.x) * 0.08;
          pointer.vy = (pointer.targetY - pointer.y) * 0.08;
          pointer.x += pointer.vx;
          pointer.y += pointer.vy;
        } else {
          pointer.x = 0;
          pointer.y = 0;
          pointer.vx = 0;
          pointer.vy = 0;
        }

        const cx = width * 0.5;
        const cy = height * 0.56;
        const r = Math.min(width * 0.34, height * 0.34, 240);

        // 1. Deep atmospheric background
        const bgGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(
          cx + pointer.x * 20, cy + pointer.y * 15, r * 0.25,
          cx, cy, Math.max(width, height) * 0.78
        );
        bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#24150c');
        bgGrad.addColorStop(0.42, '#120b07');
        bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#060403');
        ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
        ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);

        // 2. Ambient warm embers
        drawEmbers(time, dt);

        // 3. The Vegan Ramen Bowl
        drawBowlAndRamen(cx, cy, r, time, pointer.x, pointer.y);

        // 4. Rising Steam
        drawSteam(cx, cy, r, time, dt);
      }

      function loop(now) {
        const dt = Math.min((now - lastTime) / 1000, 0.05);
        lastTime = now;
        time += dt;

        drawFrame(dt);

        if (!prefersReducedMotion) {
          rafId = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
        }
      }

      function handleMotionChange(e) {
        prefersReducedMotion = e.matches;
        if (prefersReducedMotion) {
          if (rafId !== null) {
            cancelAnimationFrame(rafId);
            rafId = null;
          }
          drawFrame(0);
        } else {
          lastTime = performance.now();
          rafId = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
        }
      }

      initParticles();
      resize();

      window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
      window.addEventListener('pointermove', onPointerMove, { passive: true });
      window.addEventListener('pointerleave', onPointerLeave);
      reducedMotionQuery.addEventListener('change', handleMotionChange);

      if (prefersReducedMotion) {
        drawFrame(0);
      } else {
        rafId = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
      }
    })();
  </script>
</body>
</html>

Created [index.html](file:///app/index.html) as a self-contained HTML5 Canvas scene with zero external assets, inline CSS/JS, and no UI or text.

### What was implemented
- **Atmospheric Hero Scene**: A dark, warm-lit table surface with ambient floating embers and a 3/4-perspective ceramic bowl as the sole visual focus.
- **Vegan Ramen Details**: Rich miso/chili-oil broth with shimmering highlights, layered wavy noodles, floating chili & sesame oil droplets, charred shiitake mushrooms, crispy pan-seared tofu, baby bok choy, roasted nori, sweet corn, scallion rings, sesame seeds, chili threads, and lacquered wooden chopsticks.
- **Natural Motion & Interactivity**: Rising, swaying steam wisps that react to pointer velocity, subtle parallax tilt/lighting response to mouse movement, and gentle bobbing of oil droplets.
- **Responsive & Accessible**: Scales cleanly across viewport sizes with `devicePixelRatio` support and halts animation/parallax when `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` is active.
